selected_claim.prior_statement: The river in Paradise is included within the good given to Muhammad; the two interpretations need not exclude each other.

source.edition_locator: KSU Tabari rendering, printed page 602, page line 42; surrounding lines 40-43 establish anonymous alternative heading and then the report exchange.
source.source_context: The displayed line first gives an Ibn Abbas report about abundant good, then says Abu Bishr asked Said ibn Jubayr about those who say it is a river in Paradise, and quotes Said's reply.
source.speaker_boundary: Said ibn Jubayr is explicitly the speaker of the answer (قال: فقال سعيد). Abu Bishr is explicitly the reporter of the follow-up exchange (قال أبو بشر: فقلت لسعيد بن جبير). Do not attribute this reply to al-Tabari or to Ibn Abbas.
source.route_boundary: The broader outer report names Yaqub, Hushaym, Abu Bishr and Ata ibn al-Saib in relation to an Ibn Abbas statement. This wording alone does not justify assigning Ata an independent route for Abu Bishr's later quoted exchange. Keep full route topology and authentication unresolved.
